```yaml
name: Claude Mention Workflow

on:
  issues:
    types: [commented]
  pull_request:
    types: [review_requested, commented]

jobs:
  claude-mention:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v4
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install anthropics slack_sdk

      - name: Trigger Claude on mention
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          trigger_phrase: '@claude'
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Notify Slack on mention
        if: steps.claude.outputs.conclusion == 'success'
        uses: ravsamhq/notify-slack-action@v2
        with:
          status: success
          token: ${{ secrets.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN }}
          notification_title: "Claude Mention Detected"
          message_format: "Claude was mentioned in an issue or pull request comment."
          icon_success: ":robot_face:"
```
